decision_scope: Independent review of the minimum remaining requirements and coverage join only. The original mandatory IFUNC-offset observation is corrected below; it is not approved as an unconditional practical gate.
functional_scope: PRACTICAL-GOAL supported-profile functioning kernel and fixed useful C/Rust applications. Original comprehensive qualification remains deferred, not passed.

accepted_profile_facts.avx512: CPUID7.EBX bit16 clear and xstate bits5/6/7 absent: no current ZMM/opmask requirement. CPU model name is not proof of exposure.
accepted_profile_facts.avx2: YMM architectural state is already exercised; choosing AVX2 instead of AVX adds no separate xstate component.
accepted_profile_facts.mpx_pkru: MPX components3/4 and PKRU9 enabled. PKU is reported with OSPKE clear. Neither exposure nor OSPKE alone is used here to conclude actual use or no use.
accepted_profile_facts.multicore: One assigned McKernel CPU. Four control vCPUs do not create a current practical cross-McKernel-CPU migration requirement.
accepted_profile_facts.no_narrowing: Retain exact applications, compiler/link flags, full exposure, full0x21f save/copy/restore mask and2696-byte extent.

concrete_review_finding.finding: Requiring resolved addresses/offsets for every actually reached IFUNC/dispatch call site is stronger than the literal practical check to declare vector requirements. A state-class upper bound is sufficient when every eligible choice under the fixed profile is contained in already-covered state classes.
concrete_review_finding.logical_requirement: For fixed application/compiler/library inputs and unchanged process exposure, declare a justified set R containing all state classes the selected startup/workloads can require; join R to the accepted tested classes C. Exact dispatch identity is needed only where it changes whether R is contained in C or where an unresolved candidate uses an uncovered state class.
concrete_review_finding.not_yet_proved: These inputs do not themselves prove every eligible/reachable library path is x87/SSE/YMM-only. The conditional sufficiency argument is not that proof. MPX/PKRU usage remains explicitly unresolved.
concrete_review_finding.optional_qualification: Exact IFUNC target offsets, whole-library instruction closure, all ISA variants, broader multicore and unexposed AVX512 coverage may improve qualification but are not unconditional current practical gates.

P-M07-01.minimum: A source-bound declaration for the exact fixed dynamic C and static Rust workloads of the possible used architectural state classes, with explicit treatment of MPX3/4 and PKRU9. It may conservatively union eligible dispatch variants under the recorded process exposure instead of recording which variant actually resolved.
sufficient_paths: Bounded compiler/application/library source or retained selected-dispatch evidence establishes all relevant eligible paths use only covered x87/SSE/YMM; exact runtime target addresses then are unnecessary.

If an eligible or reached candidate may use MPX/PKRU, resolve only that distinction by targeted source/call-path or same-profile observation. Record used/unresolved state honestly; do not assume exposure implies use.
P-M07-01.constraint: No whole-libc audit, hash corpus, changed binary/flags/profile, new generic trace requirement or unconditional guest queue follows.
P-M07-01.compiler_metadata: Existing pinned target/build metadata should be reused. Query the exact retained compiler defaults only if an actual state-class uncertainty remains; absent -march=native is not a complete prebuilt-library argument.

P-M07-02.minimum: Independently join the accepted P-M07-01 state declaration to exact image08210 runtime evidence and reviewed save/copy/signal boundaries. No additional AVX/syscall/futex/signal observation is identified by this review.
P-M07-02.conditional_next_runtime: Only concrete used state outside the accepted covered set justifies designing its targeted preservation observation. If MPX/PKRU remains unresolved, retain the requirements gap rather than inventing a new runtime requirement or declaring closure.
P-M07-02.retained_limits: Existing x87 evidence is selected stack/control and MXCSR semantics; it is not exhaustive floating-point environment qualification. No new evidence claim is introduced here.

P-M07-01.assessment_note: Exact fixed C dynamic and Rust static build/library identities are declared. Direct current process exposure is recorded: CPUID7.EBX0x219c43a9, CPUID.D0/XCR0 bitmap0x21f,2696-byte extent. Remaining gap is a bounded used-state-class declaration, especially whether fixed workload paths require MPX/PKRU. A conservative eligible-dispatch state union may suffice; exact IFUNC target offsets are not an unconditional prerequisite. Preserve current apps/flags/features.
